Rated Power (W), Output Frequency (Hz)

semantic_fragments.content: The ME EQUIPMENT is classified as IP22 per IEC 60529, uses TYPE BF APPLIED PARTS with Symbol 20 (IEC 60417-5333), is intended for CONTINUOUS OPERATION, has no accessible fuse-holder, no high voltage terminal devices, no special cooling provisions, no socket-outlets, no type B or type CF applied parts, no defibrillation-proof applied parts, and no special packaging instructions. Limited mechanical stability is addressed in clause 9.4.
